performance.percentile_method: nearest-rank; report raw samples and sample count; no cross-device pooling
performance.temperature: fixed by profile; record ambient and OS thermal state
performance.concurrent_workload: generation plus 100-document indexing and one 256 MiB local test-server transfer; record resource governor decisions
performance.thresholds: Calibrate on each lowest qualified target; record independent dated threshold decision before qualification; no retroactive relaxation to pass the same run.

office.money_rounding: fixture-specific decimal rounding; compare final rounded minor units exactly
office.errors: exact Excel error token; distinguish blank, zero, text and error
office.recalculation: full dependency recalculation after edit plus save/reload; unsupported dependency taints dependent outputs

visual.mask_rule: only fixture-declared nondeterministic regions; no missing content masking

office.preservation: untouched preserve-only package parts byte-identical; relationship graph remains resolvable; supported edits use fixture-specific expected structural diffs

evaluation.grading: pinned human-reviewed expected claims/spans/actions; report numerator and denominator per metric; disputed subjective cases require documented adjudication; no dataset substitution after viewing qualification outcomes

binding_rule: Null or missing identities and unsigned/unapproved threshold records block product qualification. This protocol supplies test design, not measured results.
